# Boutique Luxury Hotels & Experiential Resorts Across India

A collection of heartwarming boutique stays across India - restored palaces, wilderness retreats and tea estates, rooted in the soul of each destination.

View All![arrow-left-icon](https://www.brijhotels.com/img/arrow-left.svg)

[![Brij Anayra Dharamshala](https://www.brijhotels.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrijcms.cinuniverse.com%2Fimages%2Fbrijhotel%2F6.jpg&w=3840&q=75)](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-anayra-dharamshala/hotel-overview)

[**Brij Anayra, Dharamshala** \\
Himachal Pradesh](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-anayra-dharamshala/hotel-overview)

You wake up to the sounds of birds chirping, sunlight peeking through the curtains without the ringing of a phone. With a cup of freshly brewed coffee in hand, you take a stroll through the tea plantations spread across 16 acres of land. This is how your day begins at Brij Anayra. If another layer of relaxation is what you seek, go for a private sound healing session and let the gongs and singing bowls work their magic. The Dhauladhar range, paragliding at Bir Billing, a match at HPCA stadium, Authentic Tibetan meals at McLeod Ganj, a visit to the Dalai Lama Temple and a trip to the Kangra Fort are just some of the moments waiting for you.

[![Brij Atmanya Nainital](https://www.brijhotels.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrijcms.cinuniverse.com%2Fimages%2Fbrijhotel%2F20260622152024474.jpg&w=3840&q=75)](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-atmanya-nainital/hotel-overview)

[**Brij Atmanya, Nainital** \\
Uttarakhand](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-atmanya-nainital/hotel-overview)

What awaits you at the edge of a hill, in a town nestled between lakes, five thousand feet above sea level? Welcome to Bhowali, in the heart of the Kumaon Lake District, home to Brij Atmanya—a sanctuary crafted from stone, wood, and countless stories. Brij Atmanya is a retreat where extended decks and gardens draw you into nature's embrace. Guided walks lead you through rich Kumaoni culture, towering fir trees, and undiscovered trekking paths. The cuisine, infused with flavors from our Natural Herb & Spice garden, offers a delightful fusion of Kumaoni specialties with Indian and international palates in mind. Rooms here come with sit-out decks and balconies, offering vistas of lush flora and the soothing whispers of mountain breezes. Here, you’re invited to listen, not just to nature, but to yourself. That’s why we named it Atmanya—‘to connect with oneself.’ Welcome to Brij Atmanya, where the serene landscape and thoughtful design help you rediscover the essence of you.

[![Brij Bageecha Kukas, Jaipur](https://www.brijhotels.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrijcms.cinuniverse.com%2Fimages%2Fbrijhotel%2F20260626124709636.jpg&w=3840&q=75)](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-bageecha-kukas-jaipur/hotel-overview)

[**Brij Bageecha, Kukas, Jaipur** \\
Rajasthan](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-bageecha-kukas-jaipur/hotel-overview)

Within easy reach of Jaipur and Delhi, Brij Bageecha is a pet-friendly retreat featuring 20 private villas across an 11-acre garden setting filled with greenery and water bodies. Each villa offers a private courtyard, while select villas feature private heated plunge pools.Explore the organic farm and discover Rajasthan-inspired experiences, including pottery, puppet shows, lac bangle making, archery, village tours, camel rides and visits to Jaipur’s forts, palaces and cottage industries. Simply pack your bags and let us take care of the rest.

[![BrijRama Palace Varanasi](https://www.brijhotels.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrijcms.cinuniverse.com%2Fimages%2Fbrijhotel%2F601a.jpg&w=3840&q=75)](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brijrama-palace-varanasi/hotel-overview)

[**BrijRama Palace, Varanasi** \\
Uttar Pradesh](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brijrama-palace-varanasi/hotel-overview)

Set within an early-19th-century palace rising directly above Darbhanga Ghat, the hotel offers a quieter way to encounter Varanasi. Architecture, landscape and local traditions are held in careful balance, creating a stay that feels intimate, grounded and deeply connected to its surroundings. Days unfold without urgency—through thoughtful meals, encounters with the destination and moments of stillness that remain long after departure.

[![Brij Casa Susegad South Goa](https://www.brijhotels.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrijcms.cinuniverse.com%2Fimages%2Fbrijhotel%2F67d950cac922c9d4af507b16_1-p-1600.jpg.jpeg&w=3840&q=75)](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-casa-susegad-south-goa/hotel-overview)

[**Brij Casa Susegad, South Goa** \\
Goa](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-casa-susegad-south-goa/hotel-overview)

Brij Casa Susegad isn’t just a place; it’s a pause button on life, nestled deep in the languid charm of Loutolim’s forested heart. This seven-room Portuguese villa, which can also be booked as a four and three-room, whispers of times when clocks ticked slower, and life was savored, not rushed. Named after the quintessential Goan way of being - unhurried, unbothered, and utterly content - it’s a retreat for those who seek to escape the static of modern existence. Here, you and your friends and family can lose yourself on meandering nature walks or find a quiet rhythm fishing by the river, as birds and breezes conspire to lull you into serenity. At Casa Susegad, the world is a little softer, and life, simply richer.

[![Brij Lakshman Sagar Pali](https://www.brijhotels.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrijcms.cinuniverse.com%2Fimages%2Fbrijhotel%2F601.jpg&w=3840&q=75)](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-lakshman-sagar-pali/hotel-overview)

[**Brij Lakshman Sagar, Pali** \\
Rajasthan](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-lakshman-sagar-pali/hotel-overview)

In the wild heart of Rajasthan, where the badlands whisper secrets of a bygone era, stands Brij Lakshman Sagar. Originally crafted in the late 19th century by Thakur Lakshman Singh Ji of Raipur, this boutique hotel was a hunting lodge fit for nobility. Fast forward to today, and we’ve reimagined this majestic retreat, honoring its past with a keen eye on preserving the beauty of its surroundings. Picture this: 32 acres of unspoiled land, where 12 independent cottages boast private pools and the luxury of seclusion. Each detail, from the historic water catchment to the hand-carved pool perched atop a rock hill, whispers tales of tranquillity and grandeur. Here, the architecture is a nod to the local, the rustic, and the utterly authentic—a zero-kilometer design philosophy that uses only materials sourced from the very earth it stands on. Brij Lakshman Sagar isn’t just a hotel; it’s a spellbinding escape into the soul of Rajasthan.

[![Brij Paraiso North Goa](https://www.brijhotels.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrijcms.cinuniverse.com%2Fimages%2Fbrijhotel%2F20260602150858186.jpg&w=3840&q=75)](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-paraiso-goa-saligao/hotel-overview)

[**Brij Paraiso, North Goa** \\
Goa](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-paraiso-goa-saligao/hotel-overview)

Brij Paraiso, a charming Goan retreat nestled in the heart of Saligao, invites you to unwind and indulge in the vibrant spirit of Goa. Surrounded by a serene forest residential area, this idyllic home offers the perfect balance of tranquility and excitement. Immerse yourself in the local culture, explore nearby beaches, and savor delicious Goan cuisine. Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, Paraiso is the ideal destination to create unforgettable memories in this beautiful paradise.

[![Brij Pola  Jawai](https://www.brijhotels.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrijcms.cinuniverse.com%2Fimages%2Fbrijhotel%2F901.jpg&w=3840&q=75)](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-pola-jawai/hotel-overview)

[**Brij Pola, Jawai** \\
Rajasthan](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-pola-jawai/hotel-overview)

Imagine billions of years of rock formations preserving the flora and fauna of Jawai. This quaint village is swiftly becoming an exploration hotspot for adventure seekers, families, and friends of all ages. Brij Pola, Jawai, pays homage to this land of ecological harmony, blending its rustic, fearless, and majestic persona to ensure your stay is unforgettable. Here, you can explore wildlife, embark on treks, visit ancient temples, and immerse yourself in its breathtaking beauty. And as you gaze into the heart of nature, you'll realize that heaven isn’t just above us—it’s within our grasp. Known for its national park, teeming with panthers, hyenas, bears, wolves and crocodiles, Jawai is also a haven for over 100 species of migratory birds. It is especially renowned for its human-friendly leopards. Brij Pola, Jawai, stands as one of the finest hotels near Jawai Dam, perfect for wildlife enthusiasts. Here, where the wild meets the wondrous, every moment is an adventure waiting to unfold.

[![Brij Sone Bagh Bandhavgarh](https://www.brijhotels.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrijcms.cinuniverse.com%2Fimages%2Fbrijhotel%2F20260618153039026.jpg&w=3840&q=75)](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-sone-bagh-bandhavgarh/hotel-overview)

[**Brij Sone Bagh, Bandhavgarh** \\
Rajasthan](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-sone-bagh-bandhavgarh/hotel-overview)

Set on the edge of the iconic Bandhavgarh Tiger Reserve in Madhya Pradesh, Sone Bagh is a serene jungle retreat surrounded by history and wilderness. Nestled in the Vindhya hills, this intimate hideaway offers a front-row seat to one of India’s best tiger habitats, ancient forts, and timeless tribal culture. Wake up to birdsong, head out on safaris through misty forests, and unwind in villas inspired by local art and nature’s calm. Here, each day flows to the rhythm of the jungle — wild yet comforting, raw yet deeply rejuvenating. Discover Bandhavgarh, one unforgettable moment at a time.

[![Brij Tara Ranthambore](https://www.brijhotels.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrijcms.cinuniverse.com%2Fimages%2Fbrijhotel%2F20260902143331651.png&w=3840&q=75)](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-tara-ranthambore-ranthambore/hotel-overview)

[**Brij Tara, Ranthambore** \\
Rajasthan](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-tara-ranthambore-ranthambore/hotel-overview)

What awaits you where the forest begins, just beyond the gates of Ranthambore National Park? Welcome to Brij Tara, a place where the pace slows, the wilderness comes closer, and every stay feels less like checking into a hotel and more like arriving at a home in the heart of nature. With just seventeen villas, cottages, and residences spread across nine acres, Brij Tara is designed for those who value privacy, quiet moments, and meaningful experiences. Wake up without an alarm, enjoy breakfast whenever you please, set out on a tiger safari, linger over dinner beneath the stars, or simply spend the afternoon by your private pool. Here, every experience is inspired by the people, culture, and landscapes of Ranthambore, inviting you to discover the destination at your own pace. Welcome to Brij Tara, where the forest slows you down and every stay feels like coming home.

[![Brij Villa Dalhousie](https://www.brijhotels.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrijcms.cinuniverse.com%2Fimages%2Fbrijhotel%2F801.jpg&w=3840&q=75)](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-villa-dalhousie/hotel-overview)

[**Brij Villa, Dalhousie** \\
Himachal Pradesh](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-villa-dalhousie/hotel-overview)

Perched atop one of Moti Tiba's highest peaks, amidst dense Deodar forests, lies our exquisite retreat—an oasis for family travelers, seniors, and honeymooners alike. Brij Villa, steeped in colonial architecture, promises a captivating stay that will leave you enchanted. Our spacious and tastefully appointed rooms, adorned with colonial-era decor and exquisite artworks, offer unparalleled comfort. Whether you choose our Imperial Rooms or Classic Rooms, each is designed to provide utmost convenience and luxury. Indulge your palate at Cedar Multi-Cuisine Restaurant, where flavors from around the globe await. Our culinary offerings, crafted with authentic ingredients and served with flair, promise a gastronomic journey that delights both heart and soul. At Brij Villa Dalhousie, every moment is a blend of regal elegance and warm hospitality, ensuring a memorable stay amidst the serene beauty of Dalhousie's wilderness.

[**Hathi Gaon (Elephant Sanctuary) Visit**](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-bageecha-kukas-jaipur/experiences/hathi-gaon-elephant-sanctuary-visit)

Nestled at the base of the iconic Amber Palace and Fort near Jaipur, Hathi Gaon, or the Elephant Village, offers a unique sanctuary for over 100 elephants and their devoted Mahouts. This serene village is not just a home for these majestic creatures but a place where visitors can forge unforgettable connections with them. Your visit to Hathi Gaon promises an array of engaging experiences. Begin with a gentle elephant ride through the picturesque surroundings, soaking in the tranquil ambiance. Witness the daily bathing rituals, where these gentle giants enjoy a refreshing dip, playfully splashing in the water. You’ll also have the chance to feed them, forming a bond as they gracefully accept treats from your hand.

[![Goan Spice Mixing Class](https://www.brijhotels.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrijcms.cinuniverse.com%2Fimages%2Fbrijhotel%2F2003813e-9109-42dc-9a50-3de23010007120260622132254808.jpg&w=3840&q=75)](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-paraiso-goa-saligao/experiences/goan-spice-mixing-class)

[**Goan Spice Mixing Class**](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-paraiso-goa-saligao/experiences/goan-spice-mixing-class)

Immerse yourself in the rich culinary heritage of Goa by learning to make traditional dry spice mixes like Xacuti or Recheado under the guidance of our expert chefs. Discover the secrets behind perfectly balanced flavors as you grind and blend fragrant spices, transforming simple ingredients into aromatic masalas. Take home not only a unique taste of Goa but also newfound skills to recreate these iconic dishes anytime.

[![Temple Tour](https://www.brijhotels.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrijcms.cinuniverse.com%2Fimages%2Fbrijhotel%2F09fcee58-960f-4f6a-b728-08e480e0f71120260615131542267.jpg&w=3840&q=75)](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-pola-jawai/experiences)

[**Temple Tour**](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-pola-jawai/experiences)

Explore the tranquil Aravalli Hills with visits to the sacred temples of Jawai. Begin at Kambeshwar Mahadev Temple, where a climb of 400 steps leads you to the serene sanctum, offering stunning views of the surrounding landscapes. Next, head to Devgiri Mataji Temple, an easier ascent of just 40 steps. Here, you can bask in the peaceful ambiance and enjoy the beauty of the hills. Along the way, you’ll hear fascinating tales about the temples’ history and may even spot wildlife like leopards or bears. This tour is a perfect blend of spirituality, adventure, and nature.

[![Recreation Room & Garden](https://www.brijhotels.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrijcms.cinuniverse.com%2Fimages%2Fbrijhotel%2F0962656f-2f08-4597-b4e0-f5be97ce5b8320260622133301306.jpg&w=3840&q=75)](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-paraiso-goa-saligao/experiences)

[**Recreation Room & Garden**](https://www.brijhotels.com/hotels/brij-paraiso-goa-saligao/experiences)

Kids and adults alike will love our recreation room and garden, the perfect setting to bond over board games or let imaginations run wild. Children can indulge in coloring, PS5 gaming, painting shells and pebbles, or experimenting with leaf imprinting—all in a cozy indoor environment. Step outside to our sand pit for even more fun under the sun, from building sandcastles to simply soaking in the outdoors. With endless ways to play and create, this vibrant space ensures a wonderful time for everyone.

## Where hospitality feels like home

At Brij Hotels, every stay is a thoughtful expression of place. Rooted in India’s living heritage and shaped by nature, our retreats are designed for those who seek meaning beyond the ordinary. From sensitively restored palaces to intimate sanctuaries in the wild, each Brij address is crafted with restraint, soul, and a deep sense of purpose.

Luxury at Brij is quiet and considered. It is found in unhurried mornings, meals drawn from our own gardens, and spaces that invite you to slow down and truly arrive. Here, travel becomes a connection—to the land, its stories, its people, and to yourself.

Discover India as it was meant to be experienced: authentic, immersive, and beautifully real.

### Why Brij?

Because we believe travel should feel intentional, personal, and enduring.

Because warmth matters as much as design.

Because true luxury leaves you changed, not just impressed.
